description: Sandbox cargo incremental rebuild is unreliable: after editing a test file, nextest re-ran a stale binary and re-emitted OLD failure text (run 01M336MYEF1R5C1JMC6WHFTCQY, seeds-540e); touch was not always enough — cargo clean -p <crate> reliably forced the rebuild. Always suspect a stale binary when a just-fixed assertion fails identically.
resolution: cargo clean -p seeds then rerun; full verify green afterward

name: serde-json-preserve-order-remove-is-swap-remove
description: serde_json Map::remove with preserve_order is swap_remove: deleting a mid-record field silently reorders remaining keys (last key moves into the hole), diverging from sd's stable in-place deletion. Use shift_remove for order-stable field deletion in tracker records (seeds model.rs remove_field, run 01M338CGYHE24Y5KXBXMB8DJWR).

name: cli-to-library-command-lift
description: seeds-0dfd: lifting a CLI command layer into a library API with byte-stable output works with a CommandOutcome{success,stdout,stderr} return (no printing, no process::exit library-side), a CommandContext::at(dir)/from_cwd() split for compile-in vs cwd resolution, and pub-field+Default input structs — #[non_exhaustive] on inputs must be avoided because it blocks cross-crate struct literals, which is the exact compile-in use; pin byte-stability with a before/after scratch-store battery diffed parse-level before any refactor

Engine checkout leaves workspace source files with epoch (1970) mtimes, so cargo considers previously-built artifacts fresh and silently skips rebuild after edits — a re-run then executes a stale binary and re-emits old behavior (run 01M39RPNKNAH1FE2998A44XKD5, seeds-de37).
resolution: After editing, touch the touched .rs files (or cargo clean -p <crate>) before re-running the binary or tests; treat a suspiciously instant rebuild as a stale-binary signal.
